reflections.summary: The opponent neutralized our rain strategy using Altaria's Cloud Nine ability to suppress weather-dependent speed advantages and outmaneuvered our offensive pressure with timely Protects, Helping Hand bursts, and Mamoswine's Freeze-Dry.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Basculegion and Whimsicott back while aggressively targeting or positioning around Altaria's Cloud Nine and Cloud Nine interaction before committing to weather-reliant sweepers.
reflections.notebook: Altaria has Focus Sash and Cloud Nine. Mamoswine has Expert Belt and Freeze-Dry. Archaludon has Magnet. Sneasler has Black Belt and Quick Guard.

reflections.summary: Won because the brought four matched the matchup: Altaria supplied Cloud Nine, Tailwind, and Helping Hand while Mamoswine converted that support into decisive super-effective Freeze-Dry damage against Pelipper and Mega Swampert. Sneasler and Archaludon also pressured the opponent's support core. No own Mega Stone holder was evolved; that was appropriate because none was needed, while the opponent's Mega Swampert was the key target.
